description: Public Utilities Commission of Sri Lanka - Publishing the names of Persons to whom a Certificate of Exemption was issued under the Sri Lanka Electricity Act
reasoning: This gazette notification involves the Public Utilities Commission of Sri Lanka issuing certificates of exemption from licensing requirements under the Sri Lanka Electricity Act, No. 20 of 2009 (amended). This constitutes a regulatory action and the exercise of statutory powers, making it a legal/regulatory matter rather than a government personnel, organizational, or specialized administrative matter.
